title: Eteocles
summary: Raleigh names Eteocles in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Eteocles, sonne of OEdipus, who refused to yeeld the yeerely rule to Polynices and slew him in single fight. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIII, §. VIII, sig. 272a
